title: UVM: Report Catcher (Waivers)
constraints: Write `class demote_catcher extends uvm_report_catcher` (with `` `uvm_object_utils `` and a `new(string name = "demote_catcher")` constructor) and public `int n_demoted, n_caught`.

Implement `function action_e catch()`: a **UVM_ERROR** whose **id** is `"KNOWN_BUG"` is demoted to UVM_WARNING (`n_demoted++`), and an **UVM_INFO** with id `"NOISY"` is swallowed (`return CAUGHT`, `n_caught++`). Everything else passes through unchanged (`return THROW`).
Match on the message **id**, not the message text, and on the severity.
hints: Demoted messages still reach the report server (as warnings), while caught ones don't.
Waivers of known bugs through catchers keep regressions green without deleting checks, and they are easy to audit and remove later.
